definitions.explanation: High temperature of objects or liquids that can be touched.

examples.english: My heart feels warm. / I feel moved.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{熱|あつ}い{思|おも}いで{夢|ゆめ}を{語|かた}った。
examples.english: He spoke of his dreams with passion.

notes:
{熱|あつ}い refers to hot objects/liquids and passionate feelings.

DISTINCTION FROM SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熱|あつ}い: hot to the touch (objects, liquids); passionate
- {暑|あつ}い: hot weather, uncomfortable heat
- {厚|あつ}い: thick (objects)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {熱|あつ}いお{湯|ゆ}: hot water
- {熱|あつ}いコーヒー: hot coffee
- {熱|あつ}い{視線|しせん}: passionate gaze
- {熱|あつ}い{戦|たたか}い: heated battle
- {胸|むね}が{熱|あつ}くなる: to feel moved/emotional

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {熱|あつ}く
- Noun form: {熱|あつ}さ (heat intensity)

IDIOMATIC:
- {熱|あつ}い{思|おも}い: passionate feelings
- {鉄|てつ}は{熱|あつ}いうちに{打|う}て: Strike while the iron is hot
